A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] '''slave''' was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dehno]], an officer of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] after the Wookiee refused to follow orders. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Zaalbar]] came upon Dehno standing over the Wookiee, but Revan was able to convince the captain to back down when Zaalbar became enraged at the sight.
